title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit325, int4 KV, 1M context, DFlash2 drafter
summary: Full GLM-5.3 on four DGX Sparks at TP=4 with upstream gr8: exlr8 bit325 (v0.6), int4 KV with a 1,130,496-token pool and 1,048,576 max context, zero-copy shared prefix pages, DFlash2 + MTP=2 drafting, bit-exact kernel paths plus MoE union cap (48 quality default, 32 fast preset), up to 8 concurrent chats, and a persistent SSD KV store. Live-verified at RealMark 1,356.8 Grade A (16/16 all lanes, 1,546.3 at C=4, 99.2% cache hit), 1,638/1,579 tok/s cold prefill (32K/128K), and 3x300K / 4x153K / 8x26K shared prefix.

configs.label: TP=3
configs.notes: bit225 experts (2.25 bpw), MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, mean of two fresh boots, GPU clocks uncapped, measured 2026-10-24 with the launcher defaults of that date.

configs.label: TP=4
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: prompt + max_tokens · live-proven: 3x300K (899K resident), 4x153K (614K resident), 8x26K shared prefix

quality.name: RealMark RIPAL (C=1/2/4)
quality.value: 1,356.8 Grade A (16/16 all lanes, 99.2% cache hit)

configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-28 on kindlingai/gr8 main (530312e6) across 4 DGX Sparks (200G switch), bit325 experts (3.25 bpw, v0.6 @ 3e388b45), int4 KV (CAP=1,130,496, 4,800 pages/rank, MAX_MODEL_LEN=1,048,576, SHARE_LIMIT=32,768, SESS=8, GR8_KV_SHARE_PAGES=1), DFlash2 + MTP=2 (DFL_REUSE_MIN=0, L2PF=31, MTP_L2PF=3, MTP_LASTROW=1, DRAFT_HEAD2=1, PF_GEMMF32=1), MOE_UNION_CAP=48 quality default. bench/bench.py default level (GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages, 0% throttle): smoke 14/14, count 3/3, cache 423/424, needle 128K (130,876 tok) PASS, 0 suspect; cold prefill 32K 1,638 / 128K 1,579 tok/s (+8.5% at 128K vs v1.1.1). Official RealMark C=1/2/4 (Thinking OFF, --probe): 1,356.8 Grade A (C=1 1,179.8 / C=2 1,369.1 / C=4 1,546.3; 16/16 done on all lanes; 97.7-98.3% match; 99.23% prefix cache hit across 305K active C=4 context; C=1 prefill floor 1,653 tok/s). Warm boot 73 s; lowest MemAvailable 5.61 GiB during bench, 5.46 GiB during RealMark. GSM8K-250 / HumanEval-164 / Fast mode (MOE_UNION_CAP=32) / 899K live stress proofs measured on v1.1.0.
